versions.changelog:
Initial release of semi-intel-platform (SemiWatch Pro) skill.

- Introduces an intelligence platform for semiconductor equipment, integrating real patent data from PatSnap MCP.
- Supports 12 functional modules, including patent competition, supply chain risks, technology gaps, policy control, and competitor analysis.
- Provides automated report generation and key insights based on user input and data.
- Outputs consolidated HTML dashboards, charts, and briefs for review and editing.
- Emphasizes transparent sources, process traceability, and data integrity.
